messages.name: Dunder Mifflin admin
messages.body: Getting IP-4090 when our job retries after a timeout.

messages.name: Maya (Support)
messages.body: IP-4090 means the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request body. Retries must send exactly the same body with the same key. This error is not retryable as-is. If the first request is still running you would get IP-4091 instead, which you can retry after a second.
